name: Taishi (Hyōgo, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Taishi town emblem in red: an outlined lozenge-shaped device with a stylised character and a disc.
history: Municipal flag of Taishi, a town in Hyōgo Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 December 1966.

features.role: Taishi town emblem — an outlined lozenge-shaped device with a stylised character and a disc
